definitions.rationale: This is the base equation of the removeVowelsFrom summary: filtering an empty remaining IntSeq returns the accumulator. It defines the named proof term and does not match or replace an operational configuration.

This guarded recurrence defines the vowel case of removeVowelsFrom by dropping the head code and recursing on REST. Its simplification attribute changes equation use, but the rule remains a defining equation rather than an additional mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule removeVowelsFrom(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq), ACC:IntSeq)
    => removeVowelsFrom(REST, ACC)
    requires strContains(
      iCons(C, .IntSeq),
      iCons(97,
        iCons(101,
          iCons(105,
            iCons(111,
              iCons(117,
                iCons(65,
                  iCons(69,
                    iCons(73,
                      iCons(79,
                        iCons(85, .IntSeq)))))))))))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This complementary guarded recurrence defines the non-vowel case of removeVowelsFrom by appending the head code to ACC and recursing on REST. Its simplification attribute applies the defining recurrence and does not make it a separately trusted domain fact.
definitions.text:
rule removeVowelsFrom(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq), ACC:IntSeq)
    => removeVowelsFrom(
         REST,
         seqConcat(ACC, iCons(C, .IntSeq)))
    requires notBool strContains(
      iCons(C, .IntSeq),
      iCons(97,
        iCons(101,
          iCons(105,
            iCons(111,
              iCons(117,
                iCons(65,
                  iCons(69,
                    iCons(73,
                      iCons(79,
                        iCons(85, .IntSeq)))))))))))
    [simplification]
